## Product image policy
- Combo products use six unique images selected from their product folder for the main product gallery.
- Individual products use all unique images in their assigned product folder to represent different product angles.
- Exact duplicate binary images were checked across the active product folders; no duplicate SHA groups were found.
- Product cards use one primary image and show the total gallery image count. Product detail pages expose the full assigned gallery.

## Customer flow
- Buy Now opens WhatsApp with the selected product name and canonical product URL.
- Add to Cart stores multiple selected products locally.
- Cart checkout sends the complete selected product list to WhatsApp.
- Share uses the product's canonical URL so the recipient lands on the exact product page.
- Product pages contain product-specific title, description, Open Graph metadata and Product structured data.

## Search / AEO / LLM
- Homepage includes Organization/OnlineStore, LocalBusiness, WebSite and product ItemList structured data.
- Product pages include Product structured data, product images, price/member-price information where available, canonical URLs and social metadata.
- Sitemap includes all active product URLs.
- robots.txt allows crawling and references the sitemap.
- llms.txt documents the product hierarchy, pricing and customer flows.
